O stranger who holds this scroll, what you are about to witness is the lifelong discoveries of a blacksmith. I have been searching for the whereabouts of a legendary weapon, and I have recorded all my findings from this journey in this scroll. A legend has been passed down since ancient times: to forge that forgotten blade, one must first obtain a dragon egg and use its contained power to craft that weapon. However, after I obtained the dragon egg, how to "craft" it became a dilemma - should the dragon egg be melted into an ingot? Or does it require some profound magical ritual? But one day, after accidentally breaking the dragon egg, I glimpsed the secret within: inside, like an amethyst geode, it was densely filled with a purple crystal. This was a major discovery! Who would have thought that a creature's egg would contain such dazzling gems! I grasped those crystals tightly, my mind already fantasizing about the discoveries yet to come, and named this material - §5"Dragon Crystal"§r.

item_tooltip.the_last_sword.defense_mode:
In this mode, the attack logic of left and right clicks remains unchanged; simply having this sword in your inventory grants you substantial defense, ideal for players who enjoy watching various mob battles.
Note: in this mode, players cannot move normally and will automatically become invisible.
item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.dragon_: A living armor designed for multiversal exploration, ensuring its wearer can easily handle various dangerous situations across the cosmos. It can activate the built-in Void Phase Device during flight, separating its wearer from the world into a pocket universe to avoid attacks. However, if energy is insufficient, the Void Phase Device cannot activate due to inability to power the life-support system that keeps its wearer alive in the pocket universe.

talk.lost_wraith.activation: Thank you... Now, let us begin. Only the honor of fighting to the death can grant me true peace!
talk.lost_wraith.death: Finally, I am free! The Ender Dragon's curse can no longer bind me! I will fulfill our pact. Take my soul stone and place it in an item with summoning functionality. When you face formidable foes, you can summon me to fight for you!
talk.lost_wraith.init_2: In endless ages, I have almost forgotten where I came from.
talk.lost_wraith.init_3: I was once an adventurer like you, but I became obsessed with power, too arrogant, and the Ender Dragon cast me into the void below. I cannot live, yet cannot die.
talk.lost_wraith.init_4: I am not undead; the power of the End keeps me between the boundaries of life and death.
talk.lost_wraith.init_5: The river of time should have erased everything I cherished, but if you completely free me from the torment of flesh, I will pledge loyalty to you and fight for you.
talk.lost_wraith.init_7: Items containing the Ender Dragon's power can free me, then please grant me peace.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.ancient_r: To think bones can move on their own—how rare.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.ender_gua: What are you guarding? Even yourself will be forgotten.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.ignis: What a fearsome flame! Warrior, you deserve my full strength in battle!
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.maledictu: You seem to share something in common with me. Perhaps I should grant you liberation.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.netherite: If you were to be released into the Overworld, it would only bring the smoke of war.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.scylla: How does it feel to live in the storms of the sky? I don't like it—it's too lonely.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.spawn_1: May I ask, are you my master?
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.spawn_2: I will fight for you until this body fades away.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.spawn_3: Finally, I can see the light of day once again.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.the_harbi: A creation of an ancient civilization? Why does it bear the visage of the Wither?
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.the_levia: Predators from another dimension are not welcome here!
